bhajan.title: Bhagawan Krishna Namo Bhagawan Krishna Namo

discourse.excerpt: Akhanda Bhajan involves constant contemplation on God in the morning, evening or even during the night time. It is constant contemplation on God during all the three states - the waking, dream and deep sleep. It is "sarvada sarvakaleshu sarvathra Harichintanam ."
discourse.theme: Akhanda Bhajan means keeping God's name alive in every moment — the goal of namasmarana is continuous remembrance.
discourse.title: Akhanda Bhajan - Continuous Namasmarana Is The Goal

reflection: Swami reminds us that bhajan is not a slot in the morning and evening — it is the hour hand of our life, steady and continuous, not the second hand that ticks and stops. Today, take the Name into one routine act — your commute, your cooking, your evening walk — and let one ordinary hour carry the Name through it. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 40, 13 Nov 2007)
seva_nudge: Offer a ride to an elderly devotee for the weekly bhajan at Sai Prema Nilayam Riverside — or sit beside someone new at today's bhajan and sing with them.
